program: Wingless attribution of confidence-gated fourth-manifest allocation failure
question: Why did the R23 confidence-gated allocator prefer [872,291,581] over equal [582,581,581] even though the selected allocation lost 13 sealed-evaluation hits?
hypothesis: Replay the exact R23 fourth manifest, construction, grids and frozen confidence-gated signal without making a new allocation choice. Measure the four intervals that distinguish SELECTED=[872,291,581] from EQUAL=[582,581,581]: added code 582→727 and 727→872; omitted structured 291→436 and 436→581. For each interval record confidence-gated predicted contribution and sealed actual hit gain. Freeze predicted_net=(added code predicted contributions)-(omitted structured predicted contributions) and actual_net=(added code actual gains)-(omitted structured actual gains). R23 already sealed predicted_net>0 and actual_net=-13. Also isolate code 727→872, whose R23 signal is motif-churn-only because gated_baseline_count=0 while motif churn>0. Supported attribution requires predicted_net>0, actual_net<0, and code 727→872 has positive confidence-gated signal but actual gain<=0, demonstrating that baseline confidence gating removed one false-positive class but left a motif-churn false-positive/opportunity-cost failure. No weights or allocation policy are changed.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.predicted_net: sum added-code interval predicted contribution minus sum omitted-structured predicted contribution
frozen_reuse.actual_net: sum added-code actual hit gains minus sum omitted-structured actual hit gains
frozen_reuse.evaluation_isolation: sealed evaluation used only after frozen interval signals are computed

classification_rules.supported: valid and predicted_net>0, actual_net<0, and code 727→872 has positive signal with gated_baseline_count=0, motif churn>0, and actual gain<=0
classification_rules.mixed: valid and predicted_net>0 with actual_net<0, but the code 727→872 motif-only interval is not itself a nonproductive false positive
classification_rules.negative: valid and the four differentiating intervals do not explain the R23 sign reversal
classification_rules.invalid: any parent, authority, source identity, split, interval identity, signal formula, evaluation isolation, deterministic replay, capacity, provenance, or accounting requirement fails

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, R23 signal, weights, gate, intervals, evaluator, attribution formulas, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: test a training-only control for productive versus false-positive motif churn before any allocator signal revision

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: attribute the remaining opportunity-cost error without refitting the allocator
